g.text: +change_status(new_status : IssueStatus, changed_by : User, note : String) : void
A user's role can change (an Administrator
turns a citizen into a City Worker), so it is
modelled as the Role enumeration, not as
inheritance. In the code, Citizen, CityWorker
and Admin are Django proxy classes of User
that only filter users by role and add no data.
